description: Defines a test server class (QuicTestServer) for creating custom QUIC server sessions and streams, along with related factory classes and a test session class (ImmediateGoAwaySession).

classes.name: QuicTestServer
classes.description: A test server class for creating custom QUIC server sessions and streams, with configurable factories and event loop.

classes.name: SessionFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating custom QuicServerSession instances.

classes.name: StreamFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating custom QuicSimpleServerStream instances.

classes.name: CryptoStreamFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating custom QuicCryptoServerStreamBase instances.

classes.name: ImmediateGoAwaySession
classes.description: A test session that sends a GOAWAY frame immediately upon creation, before crypto credentials are established.

methods.name: CreateQuicDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a custom dispatcher for the server, enabling custom session creation.

methods.name: SetSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom session factory for creating sessions.

methods.name: SetSpdyStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom stream factory for creating streams.

methods.name: SetCryptoStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom crypto stream factory.

methods.name: SetEventLoopFactory
methods.description: Overrides the default event loop factory used by the server.

methods.name: CreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates a new event loop instance.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Overrides to send GOAWAY frame upon stream frame reception.

methods.name: OnNewEncryptionKeyAvailable
methods.description: Handles event when a new encryption key is available.
